story.titleZh: 池塘边的望远镜与门槛上的拘谨

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: You use the binoculars on the stone platform to look at tree reflections in the pond. Small ripples keep changing their outlines.
beats.chinese: 你用石台上的双筒望远镜观察池中树影。细小波纹不断改变倒影的轮廓。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: Nearby, Kiptoo drinks from his own water bottle. An old concert wristband is tied loosely around his wrist.
beats.chinese: 附近的Kiptoo正喝自己水瓶里的水。一条旧演出腕带松松系在手腕上。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: I visited a new colleague yesterday. There was a cup ready for guests, and I still waited for her to say I could take it.
beats.chinese: 昨天去了新同事家。杯子都给客人摆好了，我还是等她开口才敢拿。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Out here, I'm fine. In someone else's sitting room, I suddenly get terribly careful. I did ask in the end.
beats.chinese: 在外面我挺自在。一进别人客厅，忽然就特别小心。最后我还是问了。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: He laughs at himself and screws the cap back on his bottle.
beats.chinese: 他笑了笑自己，把水瓶盖拧好。

choices.english: Ask why he waited so long at his new colleague's place before taking the cup that was already set out for guests.
choices.chinese: 问昨晚在新同事家，杯子明明摆给客人了，他为什么等主人开口才拿。

choices.english: Ask whether he is this stiff at work too, with all his colleagues around.
choices.chinese: 问他在工作时、同事都在的情况下，是不是也这么拘谨。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: He gives a short, honest laugh and turns the closed bottle in his hands.
beats.chinese: 他坦率地短笑一声，在手里转着盖好的水瓶。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Because the cup was right there, water and all, and my hand still wouldn't move. I sat there thirsty like a guest at a museum.
beats.chinese: 因为杯子就在那儿，水都倒好了，我的手还是不动。我坐在那儿口渴，像博物馆里的客人。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: I know the trick, you understand. One sentence—'may I?'—and it's done. I told myself that the whole evening.
beats.chinese: 我知道窍门的。一句话，'我能喝吗？'，就完事了。整晚我都在心里对自己说这句。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: He turns the bottle slowly in his hands, watching the label instead of the water.
beats.chinese: 他慢慢转着手里的瓶子，看着标签而不是水面。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: In the end I did ask. She laughed and said the cup had been waiting for me for an hour. So it works, asking. I just forget at the doorstep.
beats.chinese: 最后我还是问了。她笑着说那杯子已经等了我一个小时。所以问是有用的，我只是在门槛上总忘。

choices.english: Ask whether he relaxed once the host explained, or whether the stiffness stayed all evening.
choices.chinese: 问主人说明之后他放松了吗，还是那股拘谨持续了一整晚。

choices.english: Say that every household probably has different habits, so his caution makes sense.
choices.chinese: 说每户人家的习惯可能都不一样，所以他的谨慎说得通。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: He shakes his head firmly, and this time the laugh comes out easy and full.
beats.chinese: 他用力摇头，这次笑声轻松而响亮。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: At work? No. My crew would be surprised to see me so quiet. We have plenty to laugh about once the equipment is ready.
beats.chinese: 工作时？不啊。同事看到我这么安静会吃惊。设备准备好了，我们有不少笑话聊。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: That's familiar ground. I know where things go and what I can touch.
beats.chinese: 那里熟悉，东西放哪儿、什么可以碰，我都知道。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: He gestures at the pond with the bottle, easy and loose, a man completely at home outdoors.
beats.chinese: 他用瓶子朝池塘比了比，姿态放松，是个在户外完全自在的人。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: It's only the doorway that catches me. Put me in a stranger's sitting room and I go careful. Out here, under the sky? I'm fine.
beats.chinese: 只有门槛会卡住我。把我放进陌生人的客厅，我就变得小心翼翼。在户外、天空底下？我没事。

choices.english: Ask whether his friends would be surprised to see him so quiet in someone's home.
choices.chinese: 问朋友们看到他在别人家那么安静，会不会吃惊。

choices.english: Point at the concert wristband on his wrist and ask about it.
choices.chinese: 指着他手腕上的演出腕带，问那是怎么回事。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: He nods slowly, like he is checking the memory against himself before answering.
beats.chinese: 他缓缓点头，像是在心里核对那段记忆后才回答。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Relaxed, yes. Once she said 'the cup is yours,' something unlocked. By the end I was teasing her about her tiny spoons.
beats.chinese: 放松了。她一说'杯子是你的'，什么东西就解开了。到最后我都在拿她家的小勺子开玩笑。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: And her home was fine, you know. Warm, plenty of food, good music. I wasn't judging how she hosts—I was the one stuck at my own doorstep.
beats.chinese: 她家挺好的，热情，吃的多，音乐也好。我不是在评判她怎么待客，卡住的是我自己。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: He unscrews the bottle, takes a drink, and closes it again.
beats.chinese: 他拧开水瓶喝了一口，再把盖子拧好。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: So next time I'll try asking at the door, not after an hour of thirst. Small repairs, same as my scanners.
beats.chinese: 所以下次我试试在门口就问，别渴一个小时。小修小补，跟我修检票机一个道理。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: He considers this and looks toward the tree shadows on the water.
beats.chinese: 他想了想，看向水面的树影。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: That's true. Some houses you're handed a plate before you sit. Others you wait to be called. Neither is wrong.
beats.chinese: 这话对。有的家你还没坐下盘子就递过来了。有的家要等人家叫你。哪种都没错。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: In my mother's house in Nakuru, visitors got the full ceremony—kids out of the sitting room until invited. I grew up thinking that was just how homes worked.
beats.chinese: 在纳库鲁我母亲家，客人来了有一整套规矩，孩子没被叫就不进客厅。我从小以为家家都这样。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: He opens his own bottle for another drink, then puts the cap back on.
beats.chinese: 他打开自己的水瓶又喝一口，然后盖好。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: So I'll keep asking. One question costs nothing. Anyway—this water is mine, and nobody had to tell me it was.
beats.chinese: 所以我会继续问。问一句话不费什么。再说，这瓶水是我自己的，不用谁告诉我能喝。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: He grins and shakes the bottle a little, like the question amuses him physically.
beats.chinese: 他咧嘴一笑，轻轻晃了晃瓶子，好像这个问题让他觉得好玩。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: They would laugh first, then worry. 'Kiptoo, are you sick? You've said four words in an hour.'
beats.chinese: 他们会先笑，然后担心。'基普托你是不是病了？一个小时就说了四个字。'

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: I'd have to explain. That I'm not avoiding them, and I don't dislike anyone's home—I just don't want to grab the wrong thing off a stranger's shelf.
beats.chinese: 我得解释。我不是躲着他们，也不是讨厌谁家，我只是不想在陌生人的架子上乱拿东西。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: He points the bottle toward the binoculars on the stone platform, then back at himself.
beats.chinese: 他用瓶子指了指石台上的双筒望远镜，又指了指自己。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Like these—I wouldn't pick them up in your house without asking. Here in the park, different rules. The sky belongs to everyone.
beats.chinese: 就像这个——在你家我不会不问就拿。在公园里规矩不一样，天空是大家的。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: He lifts his wrist so the woven wristband catches the light, a faded strip of fabric with a torn edge.
beats.chinese: 他抬起手腕，让编织腕带对着光，一条褪色的布带，边缘有点破。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: From my first big show as a technician. We had a scanner fail and had to switch to the spare. Quite a start.
beats.chinese: 我第一次做大演出技术员时留下的。一台检票机坏了，得换备用的，开头可真够忙。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: I kept it after the show and tied the ends together. I collect the old ones. This one isn't a pass anymore.
beats.chinese: 演出后我留了下来，把两端系在一起。我收这些旧腕带，这条已经不是通行证了。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: He tucks the wristband back under his sleeve, unhurried, and picks up his bottle again.
beats.chinese: 他把腕带收回袖子里，不慌不忙，又拿起水瓶。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: The new ones open gates. This one just opens the story. Cheaper ticket, better view.
beats.chinese: 新的能开闸门。这条只能开故事。票便宜，风景更好。

summaryZh: Kiptoo在公共池边很自在，却主动自嘲去新同事家不敢拿客人杯子。用户可问后来怎样放松、不同人家习惯，或聊工作反差与旧演出腕带。每条路线结束在普通交流，不把公园里的他写成拘谨者。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: You look at tree shadows through the pond-side binoculars. Kiptoo stops nearby to put a small shopping note into his pocket.
beats.chinese: 你透过池边望远镜看树影。Kiptoo在附近停下，把一张小购物单收进口袋。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Good to see you. Got the bits for my old radio at last.
beats.chinese: 又见面了。修旧收音机的小零件总算买齐了。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: He closes the small parts bag and puts it away, well clear of the water.
beats.chinese: 他合好零件小袋，把它收好，离水边远远的。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: I'll work on it at home. These little pieces don't need a swim.
beats.chinese: 回家再弄。这些小零件可不用游泳。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: He smiles and pauses to watch the water before continuing along the path.
beats.chinese: 他笑着停下看看水面，然后沿步道继续走。
